claims.evidence: One biological sample per strain x pulse time (MaxQuant experiment, e.g. "N2_4h"); the _Lys0/_Lys8 suffix separates the pre-existing (light Lys) and newly synthesized (heavy 13C6-15N2 Lys) protein pools of the SAME worm population measured in one run, so that the (source, replicate, fraction) coordinate stays unique per channel.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:6239 Caenorhabditis elegans; paper studies C. elegans strains. OLS NCBITaxon:6239.
PRIDE organismParts BTO:0001489 whole body; worms were lysed whole (Supplemental Experimental Procedures: "Worms were lysed in 150 ul 8M urea").
Whole worms harvested, snap frozen and lysed (Supplemental Experimental Procedures, Pulse labeling / Preparation of MS samples).

Each strain x time point is a single MaxQuant experiment (one worm population per well, "each worm strain was dispensed into 7 wells ... / 3 wells ... until harvest at different time points"); no replicate populations of the same strain/time are deposited in this search.

comment[sdrf version] v1.1.0 is the SDRF-Proteomics specification version (spec/sdrf-proteomics/README.adoc: 'Version v1.1.0'); template versions are a separate track and are declared only in comment[sdrf template].
Values curated manually from the cited sources; SDRF written by sdrf-tools build from samples_*.tsv / technical_*.tsv.
Shotgun LC-MS/MS on an Orbitrap Fusion.
Templates and versions from spec templates.yaml (ms-proteomics 1.1.0, invertebrates 1.1.0); invertebrates chosen because the organism is C. elegans (PRIDE organisms NEWT:6239).

limitations: characteristics[developmental stage] is "not available": pulse started at L4 and harvest at 4-24 h spans L4 to young adult ("developing L4 to young adult"); the per-time-point stage is not stated (only "developing L4 to young adult" for the whole series), so no single EFO stage maps unambiguously and none was asserted.

"Bio21" in the run names (and proteinGroupsbiorep2tech1.xlsx in the archive) suggests biological replicate 2 / technical replicate 1 of an experiment series whose other replicate is not deposited or not identifiable; characteristics[biological replicate] is set to 1 within this SDRF.

Meaning of the _AF / _WF run suffixes is not stated anywhere; they are annotated only as MaxQuant fractions 1 and 2 of one sample (experimentalDesign / mqpar fractions). No comment[fractionation method] is asserted.

14 deposited runs (20141107_F1_HRV_SM_B1-B7, C1-C7) are left out: their MaxQuant search (20141222_sasha.7z, experimentalDesignTemplate.txt) names them only as experiments "B1".."C7" out of a 12-group A-L design; nothing public maps letters B/C to a strain (developing OW40/OW450 and the daf-2 vs daf-2;daf-16 duplicate both used 7 time points) or digits 1-7 to hours.
PRIDE lists the instrument as Orbitrap Fusion ETD; raw header and paper say Orbitrap Fusion, which was used.

Paper Methods/PRIDE prose state MaxQuant 1.5.1.0 with variable deamidation + oxidation; the deposited mqpar.xml files are MaxQuant 1.5.2.8 and also include Acetyl (Protein N-term), and the day-5 search has no deamidation. The deposited search was followed.
SILAC Lys8 written as MT=Variable as emitted by sdrf-tools search-params from the MaxQuant labelMods (light state unlabelled).

Pulsed SILAC: light and heavy rows describe the same worm population (pre-existing vs newly synthesized proteins); they carry distinct source names (_Lys0/_Lys8) only to keep the row coordinate unique.
